method: Wikipedia current events (18 Nov 2026) for the skeleton, then each item confirmed against a report filed 18 Nov 2026 UTC by Google News RSS: title, outlet and timestamp kept below. Nothing is included that only a later date supports.
excluded: Items first reported on 17 or 19 November, items with no day, sport, and market ticker noise.
